title: Allowable Charge Review of a Paid TRICARE Select Inpatient Line: Appeals and Grievances Intake Card
content:
## Allowable Charge Review of a paid TRICARE Select inpatient line — Appeals and Grievances intake card

**Rule.** An Allowable Charge Review opened on a paid TRICARE Select inpatient line records as its amount in dispute the payment difference on that line. A review is opened on the lowest-numbered paid line of the claim whose daily rate is disputed; the claim's further paid lines with the same dispute join it rather than opening reviews of their own. An Allowable Charge Review opened this way has the paid claim line itself as its subject, an allowable charge being the kind of subject that review hears. Such a review is received in time when the day it is received is no later than the line's posted date plus the review's filing deadline in calendar days, counted from the day after the posted date, a review received on the last of those days being in time.

**Reading the rule (hypothetical claim).** A stay's claim carries paid day lines 1, 2 and 3, and the daily rate on them is disputed. The review opens on line 1, the lowest-numbered paid line; lines 2 and 3 join it rather than opening reviews of their own. On timeliness: for a line posted on day P and the Allowable Charge Review filing deadline of N calendar days, a review received on day P plus N is in time and one received the next day is not.

### Invocation: `file_allowable_charge_review_fa2a3df4`

**What it does.** The appellant opens, in their own name, an Allowable Charge Review of the allowed amount TRICARE set on one paid TRICARE Select claim line. One call opens one new review case on that single line: the case is recorded as received today on the standard review track with status filed, carrying the claim number, the determination date of the line, who is filing and the amount in dispute given; no appointment of representative is marked as on file and no case reference exists until the region acknowledges the case. The appellant can follow the review on the beneficiary web portal and through customer service from the moment it is opened.

**How it is invoked.** A customer-run tool: the agent unlocks `file_allowable_charge_review_fa2a3df4` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `customer_id` | the beneficiary reference number of the patient the claim line belongs to, as returned by the beneficiary profile lookup (an identifier) | identifier |
| `subject_claim_line_id` | the reference number of the paid TRICARE Select claim line whose allowed amount is contested, as returned by the Select claim line lookup | identifier |
| `subject_referral_authorization_id` | a denied authorization the case is about; a review of an allowed amount concerns no authorization, so the empty string "" is passed (the authorization lookup returns no reference for it) | the empty string "" |
| `subject_enrollment_id` | an enrollment ended for nonpayment the case is about; a review of an allowed amount concerns no enrollment, so the empty string "" is passed (the enrollment lookup returns no reference for it) | the empty string "" |
| `subject_claim_number` | the claim number of that line as printed on the Explanation of Benefits and shown on the claim line record returned by the Select claim line lookup | verbatim: copied character for character with its letters, digits and hyphens, with no normalisation, addition or deletion |
| `initial_determination_date` | the date of the determination being contested | YYYY-MM-DD (calendar date, no time or time zone) |
| `filed_by` | who is filing, one of: `beneficiary` (the patient files their own case); `parent_or_guardian` (a parent or legal guardian files for a minor or incapacitated patient); `appointed_representative` (a person the patient has appointed files on the patient's behalf); `participating_provider` (a participating provider files on its own claim) | one of the four values listed |
| `amount_in_dispute` | the amount in dispute on the case in USD, 2 decimal places (cents), a non-negative number, rounded half up to the cent before it is passed | USD, 2 decimals, non-negative, rounded half up to the cent |

**Return.** "Allowable Charge Review [case id] opened on claim line [line] (claim [claim number]): status filed, received [YYYY-MM-DD], amount in dispute [amount] USD." The received date is today's date and the amount is the booked amount with two decimals. The presence of the case reference number indicates that the review was opened.
